title: Premium Bamboo Golf Tees
body_html:
Your swing might need work. Your tees don't. We built the Premium Bamboo Golf Tees for the golfers who snap a handful every round and are sick of it. Made from 100% bamboo - stronger and lighter than the cheap timber tees rattling around your bag - they give you cleaner contact, less friction at impact, and a bit more send off the deck. Bold colours, gopher-stamped tops, and 60 in a resealable pack so they actually stay together.

The specs

  • 100% natural bamboo - stronger, lighter, and better for the planet than standard wood tees
  • 60 tees per pack: driver tees (3.3 inch / 83mm) and short tees (2.7 inch / 68mm)
  • Low-friction design for cleaner ball contact and maximum launch
  • Consistent height so you set up the same way every time
  • Durable build - far fewer snapped tees per round
  • Reusable, resealable pouch keeps the pack together in your bag
  • Designed in Australia by Golf Gods

 

These premium bamboo golf tees are the low-friction upgrade your bag has been missing. Bamboo is naturally stronger and more flexible than the wooden golf tees most players use, so you get more rounds out of every tee and cleaner contact when it matters. The 60-pack mixes driver tees and short tees to cover everything from a full send off the tee box to a controlled iron shot, and the resealable pouch means no more loose tees floating around your bag. Pair them with a Golf Gods glove and hat for the full kit, and tee it high with the loudest, longest-lasting tees in Australian golf.

WHO IT IS FOR
Bridgestone Golf is the #1 ball fitter in golf. The Tour B RXS is lower compression and designed for players with swing speeds under 105 mph who want additional greenside spin and tour level control on approach shots.

TECH HIGHLIGHTS

FAQ
Q: What swing speed are these designed for?
A: The Bridgestone Tour B RXS is designed for players with swing speeds under 105 mph. For faster swings (over 105 mph) seeking similar greenside spin, the Tour B XS is the higher compression alternative.

Q: How is the Tour B RXS different from the Tour B RX?
A: Both are lower compression Bridgestone tour balls for swing speeds under 105 mph. The Tour B RXS is designed for players who want additional spin and greenside control. The Tour B RX is designed for players who prioritise distance and hit and sit performance. Same VeloSurge core and Reactiv iQ cover in both, different feel and spin profile.

Q: What is the 320 dimple pattern?
A: The Tour B RXS features a new 320 dimple aerodynamic pattern designed to deliver more penetrating ball flight and increased distance, especially valuable in wind and on lower swing speeds.

Q: What is VeloSurge technology?
A: VeloSurge is Bridgestone's new core mantle integration technology. It improves how energy transfers between the inner core and mantle layer of the ball at impact, delivering breakthrough velocity for increased distance off the tee.

Q: What is the Reactiv iQ cover?
A: Reactiv iQ is Bridgestone's adaptive cover material. It adheres to the clubface longer during impact, generating tour level spin and giving you better precision control around the green.

Q: How is the Tour B RXS different from the Tour B XS?
A: Both deliver tour level spin and greenside control. The Tour B RXS is lower compression and built for swing speeds under 105 mph. The Tour B XS is higher compression and built for swing speeds over 105 mph. Pick the compression that matches your swing speed for optimal performance.

Q: How many balls per pack?
A: Sold in a standard dozen pack (12 balls per box).

Q: Are these new for 2026?
A: Yes. The Tour B RXS with VeloSurge core mantle integration and the new 320 dimple pattern is the latest model in Bridgestone's Tour B lineup.

  • Front, middle and back green distances displayed alongside laser data

  • Fitted with a magnetic cart mount for convenience

FAQ
Q: What swing speed are these designed for?
A: The Bridgestone Tour B RX is designed for players with swing speeds under 105 mph. For faster swings (over 105 mph), the Tour B XS uses higher compression and is better suited.

Q: What is the 320 dimple pattern?
A: The Tour B RX features a new 320 dimple aerodynamic pattern designed to deliver more penetrating ball flight and increased distance, especially valuable in wind and on lower swing speeds.

Q: What is VeloSurge technology?
A: VeloSurge is Bridgestone's new core mantle integration technology. It improves how energy transfers between the inner core and mantle layer of the ball at impact, delivering breakthrough velocity for increased distance off the tee.

Q: What is the Reactiv iQ cover?
A: Reactiv iQ is Bridgestone's adaptive cover material. It adheres to the clubface longer during impact, generating tour level spin and giving you better control around the green.

Q: Who plays these on tour?
A: Bridgestone Tour B RX is played in professional competition by Fred Couples, among others. It is Bridgestone's top selling tour ball.

Q: How is the Tour B RX different from the Tour B XS?
A: Both are premium Bridgestone tour balls with the same VeloSurge core and Reactiv iQ cover technology. The Tour B RX is lower compression for swing speeds under 105 mph and focuses on distance with hit and sit greenside feel. The Tour B XS is higher compression for swing speeds over 105 mph and focuses on increased greenside spin.

Q: How many balls per pack?
A: Sold in a standard dozen pack (12 balls per box).

Q: Are these new for 2026?
A: Yes. The Tour B RX with VeloSurge core mantle integration and the new 320 dimple pattern is the latest model in Bridgestone's Tour B lineup.
